svg.title: Summary
svg.desc: Code design and clean code remain assets. Invest in agent velocity and reliability, use test guardrails, avoid vibe neglection, and focus on your next system design.

g.text: Code design & clean code are still the assets.
Invest in your code-base to keep your agents'velocity and reliability.
Use guardrails, like tests, to freely deploy on EoD of Friday.
Don't let the Vibe coding become Vibe neglection.
Now you can skip reading the code,and start on your next system design.
